description: Expected bytes are derived by hand from the rule text. An attachment is a fragment-IRI asc:Attachment with dcterms:format, asc:sha256, dcterms:title, dcterms:license and dcterms:source, linked by asc:hasAttachment, blank-node-free (AGSC-05-29, AGSC-05-08), and the expectation is the WHOLE dataset, so it can be compared file-against-file: the Bundle node of AGSC-05-03/05-26, the item's rdf:type/skos:inScheme/skos:prefLabel/asc:kind of AGSC-05-12/05-17/05-26, its asc:origin and asc:operator, the two schema.org licence rows on both nodes, and the six attachment lines. asc:sha256 is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the file bytes at build: sha256('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"/>') = 900fbe934249ad120004bd24adf66aad8817d89586273c0cc50e187bddebb601. Plain literals carry ^^xsd:string in N-Quads and are bare in Turtle (AGSC-05-31 form c); lines are sorted by their serialized bytes (AGSC-04-13).
